mapper.sql: EXCHARGE_CODE as exchargeCode, DATASOURCE_TYPE as datasourceType, TRADE_DATE as tradeDate, OPEN_PRICE as openPrice, CLOSE_PRICE as closePrice, MID_PRICE as midPrice, HIGH_PRICE as highPrice, LOW_PRICE as lowPrice, BASIS_CYY as basisCyy, QUOT_UNIT as quotUnit, STATUS as statusValid, null as errMsg, INPUT_TYPE as inputType, CREATE_USER as createUser, CREATE_DEPT as createDept, CREATE_TIME as createTime, UPDATE_USER as updateUser, UPDATE_TIME as updateTime
mapper.insert:
MERGE INTO MST_EXCHARGE_QUOTE T USING (
SELECT #{item.exchargeCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} EXCHARGE_CODE, #{item.tradeDate,jdbcType=DATE} TRADE_DATE, #{item.datasourceType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} DATASOURCE_TYPE,
#{item.openPrice,jdbcType=DECIMAL} OPEN_PRICE,
null OPEN_PRICE,
#{item.closePrice,jdbcType=DECIMAL} CLOSE_PRICE,
null CLOSE_PRICE,
#{item.highPrice,jdbcType=DECIMAL} HIGH_PRICE,
null HIGH_PRICE,
#{item.lowPrice,jdbcType=DECIMAL} LOW_PRICE,
null LOW_PRICE,
#{item.midPrice,jdbcType=DECIMAL} MID_PRICE,
null MID_PRICE,
#{item.quotUnit,jdbcType=INTEGER} QUOT_UNIT, #{item.basisCyy,jdbcType=VARCHAR} BASIS_CYY, #{item.quotCyy,jdbcType=VARCHAR} QUOT_CYY, #{item.dataSource,jdbcType=VARCHAR} DATA_SOURCE, #{item.status,jdbcType=VARCHAR} STATUS, #{item.createUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR} CREATE_USER, #{item.createDept,jdbcType=VARCHAR} CREATE_DEPT, #{item.createTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} CREATE_TIME, #{item.updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR} UPDATE_USER, #{item.updateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} UPDATE_TIME,
#{item.errMsg,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ERR_MSG
null ERR_MSG
FROM DUAL
) T2 ON (T.EXCHARGE_CODE = T2.EXCHARGE_CODE AND T.TRADE_DATE = T2.TRADE_DATE AND T.DATASOURCE_TYPE = T2.DATASOURCE_TYPE) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.OPEN_PRICE = T2.OPEN_PRICE,T.CLOSE_PRICE = T2.CLOSE_PRICE,T.ERR_MSG = T2.ERR_MSG, T.HIGH_PRICE = T2.HIGH_PRICE,T.LOW_PRICE = T2.LOW_PRICE,T.MID_PRICE = T2.MID_PRICE, T.QUOT_UNIT = T2.QUOT_UNIT, T.STATUS = T2.STATUS,T.UPDATE_USER = T2.UPDATE_USER, T.UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( EXCHARGE_CODE, TRADE_DATE, DATASOURCE_TYPE, OPEN_PRICE, CLOSE_PRICE, HIGH_PRICE, LOW_PRICE, MID_PRICE, QUOT_UNIT, BASIS_CYY, QUOT_CYY, DATA_SOURCE, STATUS, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME, ERR_MSG) VALUES ( T2.EXCHARGE_CODE, T2.TRADE_DATE, T2.DATASOURCE_TYPE, T2.OPEN_PRICE, T2.CLOSE_PRICE, T2.HIGH_PRICE, T2.LOW_PRICE, T2.MID_PRICE, T2.QUOT_UNIT, T2.BASIS_CYY, T2.QUOT_CYY, T2.DATA_SOURCE, T2.STATUS, T2.CREATE_USER, T2.CREATE_DEPT, T2.CREATE_TIME, T2.UPDATE_USER, T2.UPDATE_TIME, T2.ERR_MSG )
mapper.select:
select count(1) from MST_EXCHARGE_QUOTE where (EXCHARGE_CODE,TRADE_DATE,DATASOURCE_TYPE) in
(#{item.EXCHARGE_CODE},to_date(#{item.TRADE_DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd'),#{item.DATASOURCE_TYPE})

select
,NULL orgData from MST_EXCHARGE_QUOTE where (EXCHARGE_CODE,TRADE_DATE,DATASOURCE_TYPE) in
(#{item.exchargeCode},to_date(#{item.tradeDate},'yyyy-MM-dd'),#{item.datasourceType})
union all select EXCHARGE_CODE as exchargeCode, DATASOURCE_TYPE as datasourceType, TRADE_DATE as tradeDate, null as openPrice, null as closePrice, null as midPrice, null as highPrice, null as lowPrice, null as basisCyy, null as quotUnit, STATUS as statusValid, ERR_MSG as errMsg, null as inputType, CREATE_USER as createUser, CREATE_DEPT as createDept, CREATE_TIME as createTime, UPDATE_USER as updateUser, UPDATE_TIME as updateTime, ORG_DATA as orgData from MST_EXCHARGE_QUOTE_ERRODATA where (EXCHARGE_CODE,TRADE_DATE,DATASOURCE_TYPE) in
(#{item.exchargeCode},to_date(#{item.tradeDate},'yyyy-MM-dd'),#{item.datasourceType})
order by tradeDate desc,exchargeCode asc
